recommendation: Keep this commit as-is. It is a narrow current-source correction that preserves FHIR-3830's ordinary-delete clarification while preventing the history section from contradicting later applied REST interactions; no separate FHIR-16198 work is needed in this result because that issue is already represented on the combined branch.
issue_request: FHIR-3830 was Published as Persuasive for FHIR-core-http after an implementer asked whether DELETE marks all versions as deleted or only affects the current resource, and whether a client can delete a specific version such as DELETE [base]/[type]/[id]/_history/1. The accepted resolution was to clarify delete operation behavior, applied in SVN revision 3607.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by fddb306c6756dbef9b6c3632c4fa7c513ed51133, the git-svn import of build@3607, which added text to source/http.html saying that deleting a resource does not delete its version history and instead creates a special deleted history entry. Later edits preserved that ordinary-delete rule while rewording the section.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml includes source/http.html as the active RESTful API page. The page now also includes later FHIR-16198 delete-history and delete-history-version interactions, and the combined branch already contains an FHIR-16198 reconciliation commit. That later applied behavior means the old general history note saying past versions cannot be deleted was no longer correct without referring to the dedicated interactions.
reconciliation: Updated source/http.html so the history notes continue to say past versions cannot be updated, but direct readers who need to remove historical versions to the dedicated delete-history and delete-history-version interactions where supported.
source_changes: source/http.html: changed the history note from a blanket statement that past versions cannot be updated or deleted to a statement that past versions cannot be updated and that historical-version removal uses delete-history/delete-history-version where supported.
